text.tspan: AI-assisted insurance claim verification. Customers file claims and upload PDFs directly to private Amazon S3; Amazon Bedrock reads each
document, rules compare it with the claim, and a person makes every decision. Built without the AWS SDK on an AWS Free-plan account (ap-southeast-2).

text.tspan: • PDFs never pass through the web server
• No AWS credentials or API key in the browser
• Repeated submissions return the same claim
• Each claim is processed exactly once
• AI never approves, rejects or alleges fraud
